rationale: T_eff ~ 0.2*target + d fits exactly (DELAY 3 runs give d=3.848 ns at both 13.12 and 11.71 ns targets), so critical paths are likely IO paths with period-proportional IO delay; frac is at its 0.45 floor, so only d can fall. With ~+5.6 ns setup slack, timing repair never touches the critical path; gains came from slack-independent levers: timing-driven placement (~1.5 ns) and DELAY 4 (0.13 ns over DELAY 3). Two single-change probes from the best run: (1) maximum slew/cap repair margins (40%) to upsize weak IO and long-net drivers; (2) SYNTH_SIZING off, since ABC dnsize against a loose 11.7 ns target shrinks critical-path gates.
